profiles.title: Educational voice profile
sections: A reliable content workflow separates four different jobs: research, drafting, review, and publishing.
Research gathers the source material and identifies what is actually worth saying.
Drafting turns that direction into a clear argument, in language that sounds like the person behind it.
Review checks the claims, the tone, and the details that should never be left to guesswork.
Publishing comes last, after a person has approved what will go out and where it will appear.
When those stages stay visible, automation can remove repetitive work without hiding important decisions.

profiles.title: Announcement voice profile

The result is a review process that is easier to understand, without making it easier to skip.
